span.p: nonlinearity is the only thing a deep AE adds (Baldi–Hornik)

div.style: color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
§2–7 SVD · X = UΣVᵀ = Σᵢ σᵢ uᵢ vᵢᵀ — a sum of rank-1 pieces
XᵀX vᵢ = σᵢ² vᵢ, XXᵀ uᵢ = σᵢ² uᵢ ⇒ the SVD is two eigendecompositions at once
power iteration ~ (λ₂/λ₁)ᵏ, then deflate · Eckart–Young: ‖X − X_k‖²_F = Σ_{i>k} σᵢ² · the σ-plot tells you IF there is a k · on term×doc, singular vectors ARE topics (LSI)

color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
§8–15 PCA = SVD of centred data
uncentred ⇒ PC1 points at the mean · total energy invariant (5947.5) ⇒ PCA chooses how to distribute it
Iris 95.8% (⚠️ scale first) · eigenfaces PC1–3 are lighting ⇒ a denoiser · PCA is a linear autoencoder
Swiss roll ✗ (ambient ≠ geodesic) · Kernel PCA ✓ (⚠️ O(N³))

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

p.small:
fit only the observed cells (⚠️ not truncated SVD — no Eckart–Young, non-convex, biases first)
NMF: W,H ≥ 0 ⇒ cannot subtract ⇒ parts not wholes ⇒ readable topics where LSI can't (6 real topics)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
§21–28 t-SNE / UMAP · preserve neighbour probabilities, not distances
Gaussian high-D, Student-t low-D ⇒ crowding cured · KL(P‖Q) ≥ 0, not a metric · forward covers / reverse seeks ⇒ t-SNE keeps local, ignores global
perplexity = 2^H (⚠️ low perp invents clusters) · UMAP adds a repulsive term ⇒ some global · PCA → 50-D → t-SNE / UMAP
